usedFor: HelloLeads CRM tracks leads, and HubSpot receives the winners when “When Lead Becomes Customer” runs “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When Lead Becomes Customer” in HelloLeads CRM, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Won leads become HubSpot contacts, and an existing contact is updated rather than duplicated.

watchOut: “When Lead Becomes Customer” in HelloLeads CRM is polling, so a won lead reaches HubSpot after a scheduled check.
